newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kong Tai issues new shrs to fund purchase.
newsitem.headline: Kong Tai issues new shrs to fund purchase.

text.p: Kong Tai International Holdings Co Ltd said it would issue 20 million new shares, or 1.46 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$0.50 each to fund part of its HK$21 million purchase of car parking spaces.

Kong Tai said it would buy from third parties the entire Wellstech International Ltd, which owns four floors of Lisa House at Nelson Street in Kowloon's Mongkok district comprising 108 rentable car parking spaces, for HK$21 million.

It said HK$11 million of the purchase would be paid in cash and be funded by internal resources, and the remaining HK$10 million will be settled by issuing 20 million new shares to the vending parties.
The property was valued by an independent valuer at HK$70 million as at October 31, 1996, the company said.
Kong Tai shares were at HK$0.53 a share at midday, up HK$0.045 from Friday's close.
